map.输入木材的绝干重量与湿重（或含水率），计算含水率并换算收缩率，判断木材干燥程度与: Enter the oven-dry weight and wet weight (or moisture content) of wood to compute moisture content and convert shrinkage, judging how dry it is and what it can be used for (such as indoor furniture stock), for material selection control.
map.木材干燥质量评估：称取湿重与绝干重，算出含水率并判断处于窑干/气干/半干/湿材/: Assess wood drying quality: weigh the wet and oven-dry samples, compute moisture content and judge whether it falls in the kiln-dried/air-dried/half-dried/wet/green band to decide indoor usability.
map.加工前选材：室内家具通常要求 8–12% 含水率，超出则需继续干燥以防后期开裂变: Material selection before machining: indoor furniture usually requires 8-12% moisture content; anything above needs further drying to prevent later cracking and warping.
map.干燥收缩预测：从纤维饱和点(30%)到当前含水率的径向、弦向、体积收缩率，预估拼: Drying shrinkage prediction: radial, tangential and volumetric shrinkage from the fiber saturation point (30%) down to the current moisture content, to estimate dimensional change after panel glue-up and tenoning.
map.示例：橡木试样 湿重120g / 绝干重100g: Example: oak sample, wet weight 120 g / oven-dry weight 100 g
map.：含水率 = (120 − 100) ÷ 100 × 100 = 20.0%，属: : moisture content = (120 - 100) / 100 x 100 = 20.0%, which is "wet stock" (further drying recommended). The 10 percentage point gap from the 30% fiber saturation point down to 20% gives radial shrinkage of about 1.70%, tangential about 3.60% and volumetric about 5.20% (oak coefficients radial 5.1 / tangential 10.8 / volumetric 15.6, all computed as change/30 x coefficient).
map.含水率多少算适合做家具？: What moisture content suits furniture making?
map.室内木制品一般要求 8–12%（气干范围）。低于 8% 为窑干，适合精密木工；高: Interior woodwork generally requires 8-12% (the air-dry range). Below 8% is kiln-dried and suits fine woodworking; above 12% needs further drying before indoor use, otherwise it tends to crack and warp.
map.纤维饱和点 30% 是什么？: What is the fiber saturation point at 30%?
map.纤维饱和点（FSP）是细胞壁吸饱水、胞腔游离水已排尽的临界点，约 30%。低于此: The fiber saturation point (FSP) is the threshold where the cell walls are water-saturated and free water has drained from the cell cavities, about 30%. Wood starts shrinking noticeably only below this point, and shrinkage is estimated as (30% - current moisture content) / 30 x species factor.
map.径向和弦向收缩为什么不一样？: Why do radial and tangential shrinkage differ?
map.木材弦向收缩约为径向的 1.5–2 倍，源于射髓细胞与纹理方向差异。因此宽板易瓦: Tangential shrinkage of wood is about 1.5-2 times the radial value because of ray cells and grain direction differences. Wide boards therefore cup easily and glued panels open at the seams, so leave allowances and relieve stress when cutting.
